arguments.source:
(lambda (input)
  (let* ((violates (or (search "is violated." input)
                       (search "Temporal properties were violated" input)))
         (holds (search "No error has been found." input))
         (verdict (cond (violates "violates")
                        (holds "holds")
                        (t "error")))
         (inv-start (and violates
                         (search "Error: Invariant " input)))
         (inv (if inv-start
                  (let* ((s (+ inv-start (length "Error: Invariant ")))
                         (e (or (position #\Space input :start s)
                                (position #\Newline input :start s)
                                (length input))))
                    (subseq input s e))
                  "-"))
         (n 0)
         (pos 0))
    (labels ((line-starts-state (p)
               (and (<= (+ p 6) (length input))
                    (string= "State " input :start1 p :end1 (+ p 6))
                    (digit-char-p (char input (+ p 6))))))
      (when (line-starts-state 0) (incf n))
      (loop
        (let ((nl (search (string #\Newline) input :start2 pos)))
          (unless nl (return))
          (incf pos nl)
          (when (line-starts-state (1+ pos)) (incf n))
          (incf pos))))
    (format nil "~a|~a|~a" verdict inv n)))
arguments.note: Classify a TLC log: verdict (violates/holds/error), invariant name, counterexample trace length, as "v|inv|n"
